10: export function highlightSyntax(code: string, colorScheme?: "light" | "dark"): { text: string; color: string }[] {
11:   const theme = getEditorTheme("p5-learn", colorScheme || "dark");
12:   const KEYWORD_RE = /\b(function|if|else|for|while|return|let|const|var|new|this|class)\b/g;
13:   const P5_RE = new RegExp(`\\b(${P5_FUNCTION_NAMES.join("|")})\\b(?=\\()`, "g");
14:   const NUMBER_RE = /\b\d+(\.\d+)?\b/g;
15:   const STRING_RE = /("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|`[^`]*`)/g;
16:   const COMMENT_RE = /(\/\/.*)/g;
17:   const OP_RE = /([{}[\]();,.]|=>|[-+*/%&|^!<>=]=?)/g;
18: 
19:   const allMatches: { index: number; text: string; color: string }[] = [];
20:   const patterns: [RegExp, string][] = [
21:     [COMMENT_RE, theme.comment],
22:     [STRING_RE, theme.string],
23:     [KEYWORD_RE, theme.keyword],
24:     [NUMBER_RE, theme.number],
25:     [P5_RE, theme.function],
26:     [OP_RE, theme.operator],
27:   ];
28:   for (const [re, color] of patterns) {
29:     re.lastIndex = 0;
30:     let match;
31:     while ((match = re.exec(code)) !== null) {
32:       allMatches.push({ index: match.index, text: match[0], color });
33:     }
34:   }
35:   allMatches.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
36: 
37:   const tokens: { text: string; color: string }[] = [];
38:   let lastEnd = 0;
39:   for (const m of allMatches) {
40:     if (m.index < lastEnd) continue;
41:     if (m.index > lastEnd) {
42:       tokens.push({ text: code.slice(lastEnd, m.index), color: theme.fg });
43:     }
44:     tokens.push({ text: m.text, color: m.color });
45:     lastEnd = m.index + m.text.length;
46:   }
47:   if (lastEnd < code.length) {
48:     tokens.push({ text: code.slice(lastEnd), color: theme.fg });
49:   }
50:   return tokens.length > 0 ? tokens : [{ text: code, color: theme.fg }];
51: }

53: export function renderHighlightedCode(
54:   code: string,
55:   colorScheme: "light" | "dark",
56:   style: object = {},
57: ): React.ReactNode {
58:   const tokens = highlightSyntax(code, colorScheme);
59:   return tokens.map((t, i) => (
60:     <Text key={i} style={{ ...style, color: t.color }}>
61:       {t.text}
62:     </Text>
63:   ));

74:   const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
75:   let lastIndex = 0;

77:   const seenSymbols = new Set<string>();
78: 
79:   SYMBOL_PATTERN.lastIndex = 0;
80: 
81:   while ((match = SYMBOL_PATTERN.exec(text)) !== null) {
82:     if (match.index > lastIndex) {
83:       parts.push(
84:         <Text key={`txt-${lastIndex}`} style={{ color: colors.textSecondary }}>
85:           {text.slice(lastIndex, match.index)}
86:         </Text>
87:       );
88:     }
89:     const symbolName = match[0];
90:     const isFirst = !seenSymbols.has(symbolName);
91:     seenSymbols.add(symbolName);
92:     if (isFirst) {
93:       parts.push(
94:         <Text
95:           key={`sym-${match.index}`}
96:           style={{ color: accentColor || colors.textSecondary, fontWeight: "700", textDecorationLine: "underline" }}
97:           onPress={() => onSymbolPress(symbolName)}
98:         >
99:           {symbolName}
100:         </Text>
101:       );
102:     } else {
103:       parts.push(
104:         <Text key={`sym-${match.index}`} style={{ color: colors.textSecondary }}>
105:           {symbolName}
106:         </Text>
107:       );
108:     }
109:     lastIndex = match.index + match[0].length;
110:   }
111: 
112:   if (lastIndex < text.length) {
113:     parts.push(
114:       <Text key={`txt-${lastIndex}`} style={{ color: colors.textSecondary }}>
115:         {text.slice(lastIndex)}
116:       </Text>
117:     );
118:   }
119: 
120:   return parts.length > 0 ? parts : [<Text key="full" style={{ color: colors.textSecondary }}>{text}</Text>];
121: }
